metrics.name: dataset.moving_frame_fraction
metrics.detail: 827080 of 827080 presented frames contain world motion by ANY agent, camera-independent. The denominator gate.wake_fraction must be read against: a gate cannot beat the scene's own motion density, and v3 was authored to contain moving agents. This measures the gate's mechanism, not the Tier-1 economic claim -- that requires wake fraction over 24 hours of real office footage including nights and weekends, which does not yet exist.

rules.interval: mean +/- z * SE over (camera, cut) units; pointwise z=1.959963984540054, simultaneous (Bonferroni over 30 bins) z=3.1355
rules.transient_end: reaches_steady_state_k of the 320x180 wake curve: the first 30-frame bin from which every later bin's 95% CI of (re-render minus source) contains the late-chunk difference

post_hoc_excess_end.rule: POST HOC, chosen after viewing the curve: first bin whose simultaneous interval of the 320x180 wake difference reaches 0 (end of the post-cut excess only)
